products.title: Personalised Football Bobble Hat For Your Team Black/Classic Red/White One Size - Printed Full Colour Badge
products.descriptionHtml:
Personalised Football Bobble Hat Black/Classic Red/White (One Size)
Are you looking for a high quality personalised bobble hat featuring your teams badge? We will print your teams badge full colour on our high quality hats, any badge for any team: we will print!!!

Please send us the badge wanted on the Hat

(PLEASE NOT IF WE DONT RECEIVE THIS INFO YOUR JOB WILL ARRIVE AS SAMPLE IMAGE)


Personalised Bobble Hat - Badge


YOU WILL RECEIVE:
1x Bobble hat
Supply us the badge required

 

Choose Badge And Colour

TearAway label for ease of rebranding. Cuffed design for optimal decoration. Contrasting pom pom and striped cuff. Double layer knit. Classic colour combinations. BSCI certified. Reach certified.

Washing InstructionsMachine wash warm, do not iron, do not dry clean.

All our Hats are Shipped by Royal Mail





We work MONDAY to FRIDAY

Bottles ordered between 12.01pm Friday and 9am Monday will be Posted Monday!!

***Please note this product is made with images available in the public domain and is 100% unofficial***
